name: Remaining balance (insurer) line list
notes:
Remaining balance - Insurer Line List v2.24
This report generates a list of all patients that have a remaining balance with an insurer. Each row in the report represents a single patient with a remaining balance. The report includes patient, insurer and remaining balance information. Patients are listed in chronological order by discharge date.

queryOptions.dateRangeLabel: Enter discharge dates (or leave it blank for all)
